name: catalog-crosscheck-experiment
description: Phase 4 catalog cross-check: kernelCAD catalog -> CAD Script, built with Manifold and the SMLib exact kernel. Not shipped.

scripts.catalog: rm -rf .catalog && mkdir -p .catalog && git -C "${LAB:?set LAB to the kernel lab clone}" archive "${LAB_REV:-HEAD}" catalog/kits | tar -x -C .catalog --exclude '*.png' && git -C "$LAB" rev-parse "${LAB_REV:-HEAD}" > .catalog/COMMIT
